name: kframework-tsengine
description: KFramework 浏览器引擎的 TypeScript 源码。编译产物输出到 dist/<Debug|Release>/jsengine（含依赖），供各示例按配置复制到 wwwroot/jsengine。

scripts.build: node check-esm-imports.mjs && tsc --outDir dist/Debug/jsengine && node copy_deps.mjs Debug
scripts.build:release: node check-esm-imports.mjs && tsc --outDir dist/Release/jsengine && node copy_deps.mjs Release && node minify.mjs Release
